items.q: there was this other trombone player, this young red-haired guy named Kenny, and they asked him to do the tour

ctx.x: Stevie Wonder was before Duke Ellington. Wow.

Yeah. I was in Berklee School of Music in my fifth semester there. And everything started not making sense. There were too many rules. I told you, I was a rebel. You’d walk into some kind of composition class or something, and there were like twenty rules: you can’t do this, you can’t do this, can’t do this, and it was like man, this is not for me anymore. Music is not about rules, it’s about heart and soul and music. And so I left school. I had played with Stevie a couple of times when he was in town and he’d…
